units.source_text: 以前，在日本长崎圣鲁卡教堂，有一个本地少年，名字叫罗连，在圣诞夜的时候饥饿过度，晕倒在教堂门口。

en.t: Long ago, at St. Luke's Church in Nagasaki, Japan, there was a local boy named Lorren who, on Christmas Eve, fainted from extreme hunger at the church gate.

units.source_text: 幸而得到奉教人施以援手，被收到神甫的同情怜悯，才被收留在教堂中。

en.t: Fortunately, believers came to his aid, and through the priest's sympathy and pity, he was taken in and allowed to stay in the church.

units.source_text: 每次被问到身世，他都说自己的家在天国，自己的父亲名为天主。

en.t: Whenever he was asked about his background, he said that his home was in heaven and that his father was called the Lord.

units.source_text: 众人都只能笑笑了之，终究没有人知道他的真实来历，只知道他的手腕上系着青玉念珠，知道他不是异教徒。

en.t: Everyone could only laugh it off; in the end no one knew his true origins, only that he wore a blue-green jade rosary on his wrist and was not a pagan.

units.source_text: 于是以神甫为首，教堂里的众人都不曾责怪他，并且都悉心照顾扶持他。

en.t: So, beginning with the priest, everyone in the church refrained from blaming him and instead cared for and supported him with great attention.

units.source_text: 少年对主的信仰十分坚定，不像他这个年纪的少年，众长老都非常惊讶，

en.t: The boy's faith in the Lord was so firm, unlike that of boys his age, that all the elders were deeply astonished,

units.source_text: 一直觉得罗连就算不是天通转世，也是良家少年，于是都对他呵护备至。

en.t: and they always felt that even if Lorren was not a heavenly child reborn, he was still a boy from a good family, so they all protected him with the utmost care.
